item.title: Theranos Secretly Ran Blood Tests On Other Machines
item.description: Elizabeth Holmes promoted Theranos’s blood-testing technology while concealing its reliance on conventional machines. Trial evidence exposed false claims about accuracy, revenue and military use. In 2022, she was convicted on four counts tied to defrauding investors.

item.title: Police Put A GPS Tracker On Macin Smith’s Father’s Truck
item.description: Macin Smith, 17, disappeared from St. George, Utah, in September 2015. Police monitored his father’s truck with GPS, but said in 2019 that he had cooperated and no one was considered a suspect. Macin remains missing.

item.title: Hikers Found Chance Englebert’s Remains After Six Years
item.description: Chance Englebert, a 25-year-old Wyoming father, disappeared in Gering, Nebraska, in July 2019. Hikers found his remains at Scotts Bluff National Monument in October 2025. DNA and dental records confirmed his identity, and authorities ruled his death accidental.

item.title: A Boy Found $5,800 Of D.B. Cooper’s Ransom Money
item.description: D.B. Cooper parachuted from a hijacked jet with $200,000 in 1971. In 1980, a boy found $5,800 in bills whose serial numbers matched the ransom. Cooper’s identity and fate remain unknown; the FBI ended its active investigation in 2016.

item.title: Jennifer Dulos’ DNA Was Found In Discarded Trash Bags
item.description: Jennifer Dulos, a Connecticut mother of five, vanished in May 2019. Surveillance led police to discarded items carrying her DNA. Her estranged husband’s girlfriend, Michelle Troconis, was convicted of murder conspiracy in 2024 and sentenced to serve 14½ years. Jennifer’s body has never been found.
